title: Dine-in order ticket (trigger)
description: The event that starts the dine-in process: a seated party ready to order. Published by the stub generator (or any upstream) and matched by the pack's triage rule. Author this schema in the wizard — it is the process trigger, not a tool output, so it cannot be introspected from the MCP server.

ticket_id.description: Unique id for this seated party's check.

dietary_flags.description: Party-level allergens/diets, e.g. ["nuts","dairy"] — screen_allergens reads these.

requested_items.description: Optional hint of what the party wants; the server/agent turns this into the order.

tender.description: Optional first-pass tender. Set to "declined" to drive the payment-resolution loop in a demo; omit for a clean capture.
